name: HSK 分级词表 · Chinese HSK 3.0
description: HSK 3.0 characters, HSK 1-3 (1011 free sample); companion web tool turns the deck into a browsable catalogue + paged word list. Each page number opens as a tab; the number's left spine shows that page's HSK level, its tint shows study status. Toneless pinyin search jumps straight to the word. A single-card study mode carries hanzi read-aloud, English definition read-aloud and per-word Source attribution. The tool adapts to whichever HSK deck it is bound to (free sample or full 11105). HSK 3.0 汉字 1-3 级（1011 个免费示例）；配套小工具把卡组变成「目录 + 分页词表」：点页号开页签，页号左脊=该页 HSK 级别、底色=学习状态；无声调拼音搜索可直接跳词；另有单卡学习模式（汉字点读、英文释义点读、逐词 Source 署名）。工具自适应绑定的卡组（免费示例或全量 11105）。
author: Alfred Long
source: HSK 3.0 official character/vocabulary lists (public exam specification); English definitions: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0)
